name: Tofu
about: A small cream-white square tofu cube with soft rounded corners, very short stubby legs, tiny arms, big sleepy eyes and pink cheeks. A fresh green spring onion sprig grows from the top of its head (painted in the film with the character's draw hook, standing on head.top). Wants to keep napping on its chopping board.
